missions.title: Hello, bee
missions.scenario: Exchange a greeting and thank the bee for welcoming you.
missions.opening: Magandang umaga! Kumusta ka?
goals: Thank the bee after its welcome

missions.title: A polite goodbye
missions.scenario: The bee found you a seat. Thank it, apologise for a fictional bump to the chair, and close politely.
missions.opening: Narito ang upuan mo.
goals: Say goodbye or wish the bee well

missions.title: Who is with you?
missions.scenario: Introduce an imaginary friend and say something about yourself.
missions.opening: Sino ang kasama mo?
goals: Refer to a friend with a third-person pronoun
Refer to yourself with a first-person pronoun

missions.title: Everyone is here
missions.scenario: You and a friend meet the bee and two guests. Distinguish groups including and excluding the bee.
missions.opening: Narito ang dalawang bisita. Kasama mo rin ang kaibigan mo.
goals: Use kami for yourself and your friend, excluding the bee
Use tayo for a group including yourself and the bee
Refer to the two guests using sila

missions.title: Meet the bee
missions.scenario: Introduce yourself using real or fictional details.
missions.opening: Kumusta! Ano ang pangalan mo?

missions.title: Start the introductions
missions.scenario: Take the initiative when meeting the bee at a gathering.
missions.opening: Kumusta! Masaya akong makilala ka.
goals: Ask where the bee is from

missions.title: A family photo
missions.scenario: Describe a fictional family photo.
missions.opening: Sino ang nasa larawan?

missions.title: Our families
missions.scenario: Exchange details about real or invented families.
missions.opening: May kapatid akong babae. Ikaw naman?
goals: Describe your family or a member

missions.title: Lunch with the bee
missions.scenario: Discuss hunger and what you are eating.
missions.opening: Gutom ako. Ikaw?

missions.title: Choose a meal
missions.scenario: Choose a meal and include the bee in the conversation.
missions.opening: May kanin, manok, at gulay. Ano ang gusto mo?
goals: Ask about the bee's meal or preference

missions.title: Something to drink
missions.scenario: Discuss thirst and choose a drink.
missions.opening: May tubig at kape. Uhaw ka ba?

missions.title: Refreshments for two
missions.scenario: Choose refreshments and ask what the bee wants.
missions.opening: May tubig, tsaa, mangga, at saging.
goals: Ask what the bee wants to eat or drink

missions.title: Count the snacks
missions.scenario: Choose small quantities for a pretend snack table.
missions.opening: Ilang itlog ang kailangan mo?
goals: Give a quantity from one to six for eggs
Give a quantity from one to six for bananas

missions.title: A gathering for twelve
missions.scenario: Organise quantities for an imaginary gathering.
missions.opening: May pagtitipon tayo. Ilang tao ang darating?
goals: State a guest count from seven to twelve
Specify a drink quantity from one to twelve
Ask how many items or people the bee has

missions.title: Now or later?
missions.scenario: Say when simple activities happen.
missions.opening: Kailan ka kakain: ngayon o mamaya?
goals: Say whether you will eat now or later
Say whether an activity happens today or tomorrow

missions.title: Arrange a meeting
missions.scenario: Agree on a day and part of the day for a fictional meeting.
missions.opening: Magkita tayo. Kailan ka puwede?
goals: Specify a part of the day
Ask whether the time suits the bee

missions.title: Where are you?
missions.scenario: State an imaginary current location and destination.
missions.opening: Nasaan ka ngayon?

missions.title: Two stops in town
missions.scenario: Plan two stops and ask where a needed place is.
missions.opening: May oras tayo para sa dalawang lugar. Saan tayo pupunta?

missions.title: Find the bathroom
missions.scenario: Ask for a location, then give the bee a simple direction when asked.
missions.opening: May hinahanap ka ba?
goals: Ask where the bathroom or another place is
Give a simple left or right direction

missions.title: Guide the bee
missions.scenario: Fictional route: go straight, then turn right. The store is near the bank.
missions.opening: Nasa kalsada ako. Paano ako pupunta sa tindahan?
goals: Tell the bee to go straight
Tell the bee to turn right next
Describe the store as near the bank

missions.title: Choose your ride
missions.scenario: Choose transport and ask about a station.
missions.opening: Sasakay ako ng bus. Ikaw?

missions.title: Plan a journey
missions.scenario: Choose transport, ask about a ticket, and name your destination.
missions.opening: Magplano tayo ng biyahe.
goals: Ask about a ticket or its price

missions.title: At the hotel
missions.scenario: Ask about a room key and a travel need.
missions.opening: Maligayang pagdating sa hotel. Ano ang kailangan mo?
goals: Ask where the room key is
Request a map or another travel item

missions.title: Ready to leave
missions.scenario: Prepare to leave a fictional hotel for the airport.
missions.opening: Aalis ka na ba? Ano ang kailangan mo?
goals: State that you are going to the airport
Ask where your luggage or passport is
Ask for a brief wait or help

missions.title: Ask the price
missions.scenario: Ask the price and comment on whether it is expensive or cheap.
missions.opening: May sapatos dito. May tanong ka?
goals: Describe it as expensive or cheap

missions.title: Complete a purchase
missions.scenario: Buy an imaginary item, ask about a discount, and request a receipt.
missions.opening: May damit at bag. Ano ang gusto mong bilhin?
goals: Ask whether a discount is possible
Request a receipt or ask about change

missions.title: What are you wearing?
missions.scenario: Describe a fictional outfit.
missions.opening: Ano ang suot mo?
goals: Describe an item as new or old

missions.title: Help me choose
missions.scenario: Help the bee choose an outfit.
missions.opening: May kamiseta, dyaket, at sombrero ako. Ano ang isusuot ko?

missions.title: Around the house
missions.scenario: Describe an object location and whether a door is open or closed.
missions.opening: Nasaan ang upuan?
goals: Locate an object in a room
Say whether the door is open or closed

missions.title: Find the key
missions.scenario: The key is on the table in the kitchen; the window is open. Help the bee.
missions.opening: Hindi ko makita ang susi. Tulungan mo ako.
goals: Direct the bee to the kitchen
Locate the key on the table
Say that the window is open

missions.title: Your morning
missions.scenario: Describe a real or invented morning.
missions.opening: Ano ang ginagawa mo sa umaga?

missions.title: Compare our days
missions.scenario: Exchange daily routines with the bee.
missions.opening: Gumigising ako nang maaga at pumapasok sa trabaho. Ikaw?
goals: Describe an activity later in the day

missions.title: Weather check
missions.scenario: Describe imaginary weather where you are.
missions.opening: Kumusta ang panahon diyan?
goals: Say whether it is sunny or raining

missions.title: Change the plan
missions.scenario: It is raining in this role-play. Choose whether to stay home or change your plans.
missions.opening: Umuulan sa labas. Lalabas ba tayo?
goals: Ask about the bee's weather or preference

missions.title: Describe the view
missions.scenario: Imagine being outdoors and describe the view.
missions.opening: Ano ang nakikita mo?

missions.title: Choose an outdoor trip
missions.scenario: Choose an imaginary beach or mountain trip.
missions.opening: Sa dagat o sa bundok tayo pupunta?
goals: Ask about the bee's preference or the place

missions.title: How are you feeling?
missions.scenario: Describe a real or imaginary feeling without explaining private circumstances.
missions.opening: Kumusta ka ngayon?

missions.title: Check in with a friend
missions.scenario: The bee is tired. Exchange feelings and respond kindly.
missions.opening: Pagod ako ngayon. Ikaw, kumusta ka?

topics.safety: Fictional language practice only. No diagnosis, medication, or treatment advice. Real urgent concerns require separately reviewed safety handling.

missions.title: Describe a symptom
missions.scenario: Describe invented symptoms in a fictional language exchange.
missions.opening: Sa kunwaring sitwasyon natin, ano ang masakit sa iyo?
goals: Name a fictional body part that hurts
Mention or deny a fictional symptom

missions.title: Explain why you need help
missions.scenario: Explain an invented symptom and ask to see a professional.
missions.opening: Paano kita matutulungan sa kunwaring sitwasyon?
goals: Say you want to see a doctor or nurse
Ask where a hospital or clinic is

missions.title: Your work or study
missions.scenario: Discuss real or invented work or study.
missions.opening: Nagtatrabaho ka ba o nag-aaral?
goals: State a work or study activity
State a work or study location

missions.title: A busy day
missions.scenario: Exchange simple work or study plans.
missions.opening: May pulong ako ngayon. Kumusta ang araw mo?
goals: Mention a project, meeting, lesson, or exam
Ask about the bee's work or study

missions.title: Ask the bee
missions.scenario: Find out the bee's name and location.
missions.opening: May gusto ka bang malaman tungkol sa akin?

missions.title: Find the missing details
missions.scenario: Ask who, when, and why about an imaginary meeting.
missions.opening: May pulong bukas. Ano ang gusto mong malaman?

missions.title: What is happening?
missions.scenario: Describe invented activities happening now.
missions.opening: Ano ang ginagawa mo ngayon?

missions.title: An afternoon at home
missions.scenario: Describe an imaginary scene with people doing different activities.
missions.opening: Ano ang nangyayari sa bahay?
goals: Ask what the bee is doing

missions.title: Ask for help
missions.scenario: Ask the bee for help and time to think.
missions.opening: Handa ka na ba?
goals: Ask for a moment or ask the bee to wait

missions.title: Keep the chat going
missions.scenario: Ask permission to ask a question, request repetition, then say you are ready.
missions.opening: Pumunta tayo sa tindahan mamaya.
goals: Ask permission to ask a question
Ask the bee to repeat its message
Say you are ready after clarification

missions.title: A quick catch-up
missions.scenario: Exchange a short update and a friendly question.
missions.opening: Kumusta? Anong balita?
goals: Respond or give a short update

missions.title: Keep the conversation going
missions.scenario: Exchange an update, ask a follow-up, and close naturally.
missions.opening: Galing ako sa palengke. Kumusta ka?
goals: Give a short real or invented update
Ask a relevant follow-up about the market visit
